        <script><![CDATA[var ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil = Class.create();

ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.allowedTables = ["project_status", "risk", "issue", "dmn_decision", "project_action", "project_change_request", "pm_project", "pm_project_task", "task", "pm_program", "pm_portfolio", "sys_user", "sys_user_group", "rm_epic", "rm_story", "project_key_milestone_baseline", "dmn_requirement", "resource_plan", "cost_plan", "benefit_plan", "dmn_stakeholder_register", "time_card", "fm_expense_line", "sn_gf_goal_m2m_relationship", "fiscal_period", "sn_plng_att_core_resource_assignment"];

ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.createDynamicSchemaObj = function() {
    let tables = ["project_status", "risk_baseline", "project_action_baseline", "dmn_decision_baseline", "issue_baseline", "project_change_request_baseline", "project_key_milestone_baseline", "pm_project"];
    const rootTable = 'project_status';

    var dynamicSchemaObj = {
        "rootTable": rootTable,
        "pageTitle": "Project status report",
    };

    ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.createTableFields(rootTable, dynamicSchemaObj);

    for (let i = 0; i < tables.length; i++) {
        let tableName = tables[i];
        if (dynamicSchemaObj[tableName]) continue;
        // Retrieve table label
        const gr = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object');
        gr.addQuery('name', tableName);
        gr.query();
        if (gr.next()) {
            let label = gr.getValue('label').replace(/Baseline/i, '').trim();
            dynamicSchemaObj[rootTable][tableName] = {
                "displayValue": label,
                "isReference": true,
                "referenceDataKey": tableName,
                "isTable": true
            };
			ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.applyFilter(tableName, dynamicSchemaObj[rootTable]);
            ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.createTableFields(tableName, dynamicSchemaObj);
        }
    }

    return dynamicSchemaObj; // Return the JSON as a string
};

ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.createTableFields = function(table, dynamicSchemaObj) {
    if (dynamicSchemaObj[table]) return; // Prevent infinite loops
    try {
        dynamicSchemaObj[table] = {}; // Initialize the table object
        const gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        let fields = gr.getElements();
        for (let num = 0; num < fields.length; num++) {
            let ed = fields[num].getED();
            let columnName = ed.getName();
            let referenceTable = null;
            let columnLabel = ed.getLabel();
            if (ed.getInternalType() == 'reference') {
                var element = gr.getElement(columnName);
                referenceTable = element.getReferenceTable();
            }
            dynamicSchemaObj[table][columnName] = {
                "displayValue": columnLabel,
                "isReference": false
            };
            if (referenceTable && this.isReferenceAllowed(referenceTable)) {
                dynamicSchemaObj[table][columnName].isReference = true;
                dynamicSchemaObj[table][columnName].referenceDataKey = referenceTable;
                this.createTableFields(referenceTable, dynamicSchemaObj);
            } else {
                dynamicSchemaObj[table][columnName].referenceDataKey = "undefined";
            }
        }
        if (table == 'project_key_milestone_baseline') {
            dynamicSchemaObj[table]['variance'] = {
                "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Variance'),
                "isReference": false,
                "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                "isDynamicColumn": true
            };
        } else if (table == 'project_status') {
            dynamicSchemaObj[table]['cost_data'] = {
                "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Cost data'),
                "isReference": true,
                "isTable": true,
                "referenceDataKey": "cost_data",
                "isDynamicColumn": true
            };
            dynamicSchemaObj[table]['resource_data'] = {
                "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Resource data'),
                "isReference": true,
                "isTable": true,
                "referenceDataKey": "resource_data",
                "isDynamicColumn": true
            };
            dynamicSchemaObj[table]['status_history'] = {
                "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Status history'),
                "isReference": true,
                "isTable": true,
                "referenceDataKey": "status_history",
                "isDynamicColumn": true
            };

            dynamicSchemaObj['cost_data'] = {
                'label': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Fiscal year'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                },
                'planned': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Planned'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                },
                'actual': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Actual'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                }
            };
            dynamicSchemaObj['resource_data'] = {
                'label': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Fiscal year'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                },
                'allocated': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Allocated'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                },
                'actual': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Actual'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                }
            };
            dynamicSchemaObj['status_history'] = {
                'status_date': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Status date'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                },
                'overall': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Overall'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                },
                'schedule': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Schedule'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                },
                'cost': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Cost'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                },
                'resource': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Resource'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                },
                'scope': {
                    "displayValue": gs.getMessage('Scope'),
                    "isReference": false,
                    "referenceDataKey": "undefined",
                    "isDynamicColumn": true
                }
            };
        }
    } catch (error) {
        gs.error("Error while creating dynamic json: " + error);
    }
};

ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.isReferenceAllowed = function(referenceTable) {
    try {
        return this.allowedTables.includes(referenceTable);
    } catch (error) {
        gs.error("Error while checking refernced table in dynamic json: " + error);
        return false;
    }
};

ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.extractContentTextByFields = function(contentArray, targetFields) {
    try {
        var result = {};

        for (var i = 0; i < contentArray.length; i++) {
            var groupBlock = contentArray[i];

            if (groupBlock.content) {
                for (var j = 0; j < groupBlock.content.length; j++) {
                    var paragraph = groupBlock.content[j];

                    if (paragraph.attrs &&
                        paragraph.attrs.associatedRecordField &&
                        targetFields.includes(paragraph.attrs.associatedRecordField.field)) {

                        var targetField = paragraph.attrs.associatedRecordField.field;

                        if (paragraph.content && paragraph.content.length > 0) {

                            var innerContent = paragraph.content[0];

                            if (innerContent.type === 'text') {
                                result[targetField] = innerContent.text;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return result;
    } catch (error) {
        gs.error("Error while extracting content text: " + error);
        return null;
    }
};

ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.getPageActions = (projectId, table) => {
	const actions = [{
            id: 'create_status_report',
            label: gs.getMessage('Create status report')
            }, {
            id: 'create_new_from_template',
            label: gs.getMessage('Create new from template')
            }
		];

	if(ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.isEmptyContentStatusReportExist(projectId, table)) {
		actions.push({
			id: 'import_existing_status_report',
			label: gs.getMessage('Import existing status report')
		});
	}

	return actions;
};

ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.isEmptyContentStatusReportExist = (projectId, table) => { 
	return ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.getEmptyContentStatusReports(projectId, table, 1).next();
};

ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.getEmptyContentStatusReports = (projectid, table = 'project_status', limit) => {
	const gr = new GlideRecord(table);
	gr.addQuery('project', projectid);
	gr.addNullQuery('content');
	gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
	if(limit)
		gr.setLimit(limit);
	gr.query();
	return gr;
};

ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.isContentExist = (statusReportId) => {
	const statusReportGr = ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getRecord('project_status', statusReportId);
	return global.JSUtil.notNil(statusReportGr.getValue('content')) ? true : false;
};

ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.applyFilter = (tableName, dynamicSchemaObj) => {
	if(tableName === 'risk_baseline' || tableName === 'project_action_baseline' || tableName === 'dmn_decision_baseline' || tableName === 'issue_baseline' || tableName === 'project_change_request_baseline')
		dynamicSchemaObj[tableName].queryFilter = "show_on_status_report=true";
};

ProjectWorkspaceStatusReportUtil.isValidDynamicTemplate = (templateId) => {
	templateId = templateId || ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getProperty('sn_pw.project_status_report_default_templateId');
	const templateGr = ProjectWorkspaceUtil.getRecord('sn_doc_page_template', templateId);
	return templateGr.isValidRecord() && templateGr.getValue("is_dynamic") == "1";
};
]]></script>
